project.name: Autonomous City Recovery Planner
project.summary: A hybrid planning system that turns public city-state observations into recovery priorities, projects them through exact feasibility constraints, and evaluates the resulting plans on matched synthetic disaster tapes.
project.metric_note: This is a planning system, not a classifier. Report resilience AUC, cumulative service loss, matched-scenario wins, replay, and constraint violations instead of generic accuracy.

tracks.name: Production demo v2
tracks.role: Finished policy used by the original interactive demo

architecture.family: MLP PPO with deterministic ONNX export and feasibility projection
architecture.inputs: 33 normalized city, shock, budget, depot-stock, and throughput features

training.note: One PPO seed trained on 32 synthetic scenario units across four training families.

evaluation.headline: Won 32 of 40 held-out synthetic scenarios on resilience AUC.

metrics.label: AI resilience AUC
metrics.note: Higher is better.

metrics.label: GLOP resilience AUC
metrics.note: Matched visible-information OR-Tools comparator.

metrics.label: Relative resilience gain
metrics.note: Relative difference in mean resilience AUC, not classification accuracy.

metrics.label: Matched scenario wins
metrics.note: The baseline was higher in the remaining eight scenarios; there were no ties.

metrics.label: Held-out scenarios
metrics.note: Five held-out scenario families with eight seeds per family.

metrics.label: Baseline scenario wins
metrics.note: There were no tied resilience-AUC outcomes.

metrics.label: Determinism executions
metrics.note: Five canonical repeats for each of 40 evaluation cases.

metrics.label: Determinism mismatches
metrics.note: Canonical result bytes were identical across repeats.

limitations: Synthetic-only benchmark; it is not evidence of real-city effectiveness.
Only one policy-training seed was used.
The model won the primary resilience-AUC comparison but did not win every secondary metric.

tracks.name: Adaptive Cascade MLP v2 (300k)
tracks.role: Trained model for the sealed artificial pattern-learning showcase

architecture.family: Supervised 300k-parameter multilayer perceptron with deterministic ONNX export
architecture.inputs: 21 public observable telemetry and recovery-state features

training.note: 9,600 labeled windows from 800 synthetic training scenarios; 120 supervised epochs completed in 66.73 seconds.

evaluation.headline: Passed the registered objective in 38 of 40 sealed synthetic scenarios; head-to-head, the learned policy won 38 scenarios and tied two.

metrics.label: Learned-policy objective passes
metrics.note: A pass contains at least 10 of 12 cascade windows.

metrics.label: Static-heuristic objective passes
metrics.note: This is an independent objective count, not the complement of the model count.

metrics.label: Learned head-to-head wins
metrics.note: Matched-tape comparison on cascade windows contained.

metrics.label: Heuristic head-to-head wins
metrics.note: The remaining two matched scenarios were exact ties.

metrics.label: Head-to-head ties
metrics.note: Exact equality in integer contained-window count.

metrics.label: Mean contained-window advantage
metrics.note: Paired bootstrap 95% CI: [1.775, 2.750].

limitations: Purpose-built artificial patterns; not evidence of real-disaster performance.
The static heuristic intentionally uses visible need without learning the public telemetry mapping.
Objective pass counts are independent; they are not a single complementary win/loss scoreline.
Version 1 remains preserved as immutable archived predecessor evidence; its rows and results are not reused as Version 2 evidence.

tracks.name: Scientific relational GNN v4

architecture.family: Relational graph neural network PPO with a shared QP feasibility layer
architecture.runtime: Stable-Baselines3 PPO on CPU for the preserved preliminary run

training.note: 4,096 transitions per seed for the main relational model. The complete seven-configuration suite used 86,016 transitions.

evaluation.headline: The relational model was slightly worse than the selected heuristic on the primary service-loss metric, while improving some unmet-need and worst-district metrics.

metrics.label: Relational GNN service loss
metrics.note: Mean cumulative critical-service days lost; lower is better.

metrics.label: Selected heuristic service loss
metrics.note: Validation-selected needs-weighted heuristic with fixed reserve.

metrics.label: Primary mean improvement
metrics.note: Negative means the learned model was worse on this lower-is-better metric.

metrics.label: Primary paired wins
metrics.note: Preliminary paired evaluation across three policy seeds and 60 scenario instances.

limitations: Explicitly preliminary and not claim-eligible.
Training and scenario counts were below the preregistered final-evidence thresholds.
Only one held-out topology family was evaluated.

tracks.name: CUDA relational pilot R9

architecture.family: Behavior-cloned relational GNN PPO with shared feasibility projection
architecture.inputs: Public district-sector graph observation and recovery context
architecture.runtime: PyTorch CUDA on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050

training.note: The promoted candidate reached 280,000 transitions independently on each of two seeds; 560,000 is their aggregate, not one continuous model run.

evaluation.headline: The promoted candidate improved through 250k transitions, regressed by 280k, and ended in a preregistered NO_GO selection.

metrics.label: Two-seed primary mean at 250k
metrics.note: Mean of the two preserved 250k checkpoints; lower is better.

metrics.label: Two-seed primary mean at 280k
metrics.note: The later checkpoint was worse, so the learning curve was not stably improving.

metrics.label: Final matched training seeds
metrics.note: Both final checkpoints were evaluated on the same 20 validation tapes.

metrics.label: Pilot selection
metrics.note: No finalist was authorized for the final campaign.

limitations: Developmental v5 simulator and model-selection evidence; not operationally validated.
The final candidate ranking was incomplete because a parameter-matched alternative architecture was absent.
The 280k learning curve was not stably improving.

tracks.name: Structured graph scheduler R22 / V10
tracks.role: Most ambitious architecture and pre-training reachability study

architecture.family: Typed heterogeneous graph transformer, separate actor/critic GRUs, structured decoder, and exact solver-guided scheduling
architecture.inputs: Public belief graph, project state, crew/material state, dependencies, and recurrent context
architecture.outputs: Structured project selections, allocations, reserve, and multi-horizon schedule controls
architecture.runtime: Planned PyTorch CUDA stack; no trained checkpoint exists

training.hardware: Training was planned for cuda:0 but never authorized
training.note: R22 received zero optimizer updates and zero production-training transitions. V10 was a bounded search diagnostic, not neural training.

evaluation.headline: A future-informed developmental search found 7.34% reduction, below the preregistered 40% reachability gate, so training was stopped before it began.

metrics.label: Diagnostic candidate cost
metrics.note: Achieved feasible search witness on seed 530004; lower is better.

metrics.label: Pinned comparator cost
metrics.note: Same synthetic tape and exact mechanics.

metrics.label: Reachability reduction
metrics.note: Privileged, future-tape developmental result; not trained-model performance.

metrics.label: Required training gate
metrics.note: The diagnostic had to meet this floor before neural training could be authorized.

metrics.label: Exact simulator calls
metrics.note: Includes 8,376 search attempts and 30 independent replay transitions.

metrics.label: Novel actions selected
metrics.note: The broader action menu worked mechanically but did not approach the 40% target.

limitations: This is a privileged future-tape developmental diagnostic, not deployable public-policy performance.
Only the first preregistered seed ran because it failed the 40% gate.
The search was bounded and therefore is not a proof that stronger architectures are impossible.
No R22 neural model was trained or exported.

pipeline.label: Observe
pipeline.detail: Build a public city-state representation from service damage, topology, projects, resources, crews, logistics, and uncertainty.

pipeline.label: Propose
pipeline.detail: A learned policy assigns strategic priorities or structured project choices.

pipeline.label: Decode
pipeline.detail: Translate neural outputs into concrete district-sector projects, allocations, and reserve decisions.

pipeline.label: Make feasible
pipeline.detail: An exact optimization layer enforces budget, crew, material, accessibility, dependency, and reserve constraints.

pipeline.label: Simulate
pipeline.detail: Execute the feasible plan on the same deterministic synthetic disaster tape used by its comparator.

pipeline.label: Verify
pipeline.detail: Record endpoint metrics, constraint counts, hashes, matched comparisons, and independent replay evidence.

benchmark.name: Adaptive Cascades Synthetic Showcase v2

objective.label: Contain at least 10 of 12 cascade windows
objective.definition: A scenario passes when at least 10 of 12 hidden cascade windows are contained by the public action chosen for that window.

metric.label: Cascade windows contained per scenario
metric.tie_rule: exact equality in integer contained-window count

benchmark.synthetic_disclosure: Engineered synthetic benchmark of learnable observable patterns; not real-world validation.
limitations: Purpose-built artificial patterns; not evidence of real-disaster performance.
The static heuristic intentionally uses visible need without learning the public telemetry mapping.
Objective pass counts are independent; they are not a single complementary win/loss scoreline.
Version 1 remains preserved as immutable archived predecessor evidence; its rows and results are not reused as Version 2 evidence.
benchmark.note: The 38/40 learned-policy and 20/40 static-heuristic figures are independent objective pass counts. The complementary matched head-to-head scoreline is 38 learned wins, 0 heuristic wins, and 2 ties.
